conventions.axes: Blender: Z up, animal faces -Y, origin on the ground under the body centre. GLB files are glTF Y-up: Blender (x, y, z) -> glTF (x, z, -y). All numbers in this file are in Blender axes.
conventions.joints: segment.joint = pivot of the segment in the animal rest space (studs, from the animal origin)
conventions.keys: per clip, per segment: loc = offset from the rest position [frame, dx, dy, dz, interp], rot = Euler XYZ degrees [frame, rx, ry, rz, interp], scale = factor [frame, sx, sy, sz, interp]; interp B = bezier ease, L = linear, C = constant. Frames are clip-local and start at 1.
conventions.root: the root segment is the whole animal: Reveal keys of root are offsets from the final standing spot; the bush centre is at (0, +bush_distance, 0) from that spot
conventions.fx: fx objects are not in an_<id>.glb. fx keys: loc relative to the final spot (bush fx: relative to the bush origin), scale factor, alpha 0..1. Segments named fxs_* are permanent effects (aura, sparks, motes): ParticleEmitters in Roblox.
conventions.glow: glow = brightness channel 0..1 for Neon segments [frame, value] (in Blender it is shown as a scale pulse)
conventions.stud_material: stud pitch 0.25 stud; UV: 1 UV unit = 1 stud of length = 4 studs of the grid = one studs_tile.png; checker cells are 2x2 grid studs; box projection with the same density on every part
